reason_detail: Liquidation - FMA investigation into insurance reserves fraud
notes: IPO Oct 2015 at $3.45. Peak $4.58 Nov 2017. FMA flagged solvency concerns Jan 2018. Shares suspended Feb 8 2018 at ~$1.04 after crash from ~$3.30. Voluntary admin Feb 23 2018. Liquidation 2019. Total loss. Classic value trap: appeared cheap on P/E before fraud revealed.

reason_detail: Liquidation - cash burn exhausted with no path to profitability
notes: IPO Jul 2013 at $1.72. Peak ~$3.75 in 2014. Never profitable. Steady decline as revenue failed to cover cash burn. Suspended Oct 2016 at ~$0.07. Voluntary admin Oct 26 2016. Delisted May 2017. Total loss. Pre-revenue tech stock; not scorable on value or quality.
